authority: Latest owner-selected conveyor R1 and core R4; current 36-cell matrix; register-free self-service rule. No prior static score is inherited for new evidence.
approval_boundary: Static illustrated concepts only. No native mesh, continuous motion, collision, inventory, routing logic or runtime conformity approval.
scope: Six connected-use static studies: left/right loaded turns, descending landing, joined coupler, right diverter and branch-full hold.
passing_observations: The two turn panels provide distinct left and right placements, continuous roller arcs and a depicted large raw fish within each carrying lane at the shown pose.
The descending panel labels the higher IN and lower OUT, shows a supported transition into a level landing and a receiving stop.
The joined-coupler panel shows two physically joined modules and a side support close-up with a bridge spanning the joint.
The branch-full panel has a physical upstream cross-lane stop holding an additional fish, a closed non-selected branch gate, finite loaded downstream stock and a terminal stop.
C1 and the owner-approved size family remain stable; top raw-fish transport fit tests are valid raw transport examples and should not be recolored.

defects.finding: In BRANCH FULL, the full buffer attaches beside the right diverter branch, while the signed OUT end remains at its rear tip. The transport axis changes without a visible corner or continuous end-to-end connector.
defects.repair: Attach a supported buffer collinearly to the actual right OUT mating face, or insert a clearly visible supported curved connector. Keep terminal and upstream stops.

defects.finding: The DIVERTER RIGHT central selector retains the same visible orientation as routing R2’s generic diverter. A closed left branch gate alone does not establish the required opposite selector pose or a clear rightward channel. The blocked-branch panel repeats this pose.
defects.repair: Mirror/rotate the central guide toward the left side of its pivot so the rightward path is clearly open; use the same right-selected guide pose in BRANCH FULL.

defects.finding: Only the two bottom diverter panels use blue raw fish as the prepared-food routing example.
defects.repair: Use canonical golden striped cooked_fish in the two bottom diverter panels only. Preserve top-row raw-fish fit tests.
